name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that shrinks and speeds up AI models so they can run directly on everyday chips and cameras instead of needing an expensive cloud GPU for every request.
buyer: A hardware or systems integrator building a product with a camera or sensor (factory QC, retail analytics, security) who needs AI running on-device for cost or latency reasons, not a typical app developer.
business_use_cases: A manufacturing QC vendor runs a defect-detection model on cheap on-site hardware instead of paying ongoing cloud GPU bills per camera.
A retail analytics startup counts foot traffic and shelf interactions on in-store edge boxes rather than streaming video to the cloud.
A security-camera startup ships smarter on-device alerts (person vs. package vs. animal) without a per-camera cloud inference bill eating their margin.

money_ideas.idea: Sell hardware+software bundles (camera or sensor box pre-loaded with an optimized model) as a one-time purchase
Managed edge-AI deployment and model-update service for clients running many devices

steal_this: This is a toolkit for hardware integrators, not a weekend consumer project - skip it unless you're already building a device with a camera or sensor.
